children: Sweden biopharma firm's Q2 income rose, loss before tax narrowed on higher sales, lower costs
Loss per share for Q2 improved to SEK 0.01 from SEK 0.02
Company secured SEK 30 mln convertible loan to accelerate XSTEM® development and repay debt
Company did not provide specific guidance for future quarters or full-year results
EQGEN PROJECT - Co said increased net sales in Q2 were driven by work on the EQGen project
LOWER COSTS - Co said reduced costs contributed to improved pre-tax result in Q2
